body:
I thought Louie Giglio handled his invitation to pray (and subsequent withdrawal) at the inauguration with a lot of class. I’ve met Louie, and although I don’t know what his precise views on homosexuality are today (how many of us would like to be defined by sermons or statements from twenty years ago?), I do know that he’s a nice guy with a good heart. Now there’s a lot of discussion about who will be chosen in his place. People have been putting forward suggestions – I even made one list. No call yet!
